fitting: Balanced binary correct/incorrect annotated-source match loss; 256 sampled eligible pixels per image; 30 epochs Adam lr .01 batch4096; .001 squared L2 penalty on slope/offset vectors.
head: 16-dimensional PCA of 120 seen source text embeddings; a=1+.75*tanh(PCA(text)@w); b=PCA(text)@v+intercept. Zero initialized residual, fixed epoch count.
negatives: Other 119 seen ADE150 annotation classes at each fitting pixel. Held-out and added classes excluded from training candidates. Incorrect under exclusive ADE annotation, not a claim of semantic absence.
held_out_definition: Same 30 source text neighbors of person as prior pilot; excluded positive pixels AND candidate labels from training. Excluded positive pixels from tuning. Source text remains in the fixed denominator.
selection: Minimize mean set size equally averaged over 5 vocabularies on tune_eval; thresholds from tune_cal non-held-out pixels. Gamma=0 eligible, ties favor smaller gamma. No evaluation-based selection.
reference: Unchanged natural-wording 150-label reference; same cached image features, embeddings and split as prior pilot.
scope: Development only: prior inspected results motivated this method. No confirmation, group coverage, new-true-class guarantee, or causal backbone-training claim.
